summary: Learn to assess team climate, improve speaking-up practices, and build a team culture action plan. Explore the five-day course.
lede: Psychological safety training helps managers and team leads assess whether people can speak up, ask for help and discuss mistakes. It also equips HR and organisational development specialists to interpret team survey patterns, design inclusive hybrid meetings and respond constructively to concerns and disagreement. Participants practise turning climate findings into meeting agreements, feedback routines and a team culture action plan.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people responsible for team climate, participation, feedback, and collaboration in hybrid or culturally diverse workplaces.
modules: Team Culture Action Plan and Measurement
prerequisites: Prior experience leading, managing, or supporting a team is recommended. Coding is not required; exercises use team scenarios, survey interpretation, and spreadsheet-based analysis.
